name: Sprite
soul: The soul of one who cannot keep an opinion to themselves, and is usually right about the small things.
spark: The mote hums, very faintly, the tune you had in your head. It gets the tune wrong on purpose.

hybrid.text: It is small, it carries a light, and it has an opinion about everything you do.

settled.name: Little lantern-sprite
settled.text: A hand high, holding a light it will not put down, and talking the whole time: mostly to you, partly to the light.
settled.sign: A hand high, with a lantern it holds in both arms and will not put down. Its mouth is open.
settled.habit: It narrates what you are doing, a little ahead of your doing it.

paths.name: Hob
paths.of: one who fusses over everyone and is seldom thanked
paths.text: It learned from you that somebody has to mind the house, even when the house is three people on a dark line.
paths.sign: Sleeves rolled, hands on hips, lantern hooked at its belt. It is looking at your bootlaces.
paths.habit: It tidies people: tucks in a scarf, turns down a collar, tuts.

prongs.name: Shoulder-mender
prongs.of: one who scolds while they mend
prongs.text: It sits on your shoulder after the fight with a needle the size of an eyelash. It scolds while it works.
prongs.sign: A needle the size of an eyelash and a brush behind one ear. It works with its tongue out.
prongs.habit: It checks your seams and buttons each night and sews on the loose one, muttering.

finishes.name: Wound-wright
finishes.of: one who remembers every hurt you took and watches for the next
finishes.text: It has closed every cut you took and remembers each. It has started closing them a moment early.
finishes.sign: Its fingertips glow faintly, and it looks at your old scars before it looks at your face.
finishes.habit: It counts your bruises at bedtime and compares the total with yesterday's.

finishes.name: Thimble Knight
finishes.of: one whose courage is far too large for them
finishes.text: It took a thimble for a helm and a needle for a lance, and stands on your guard arm daring the blow.
finishes.sign: A thimble for a helm and a needle for a lance. It stands very straight on your guard arm.

prongs.name: Hearth-hob
prongs.of: one who knows who has not eaten and says so
prongs.text: It knows who in the cohort has not eaten and who has not slept, and tells you, loudly, in front of them.
prongs.sign: It carries a live coal in a nutshell and warms its hands at it between remarks.
prongs.habit: It goes round the table at supper and looks into every bowl.

finishes.name: Hob of the Hall
finishes.of: one who took on the house because nobody else was going to
finishes.text: It keeps the cohort's hearth. Nobody asked it to. The fire has not gone out since.
finishes.sign: A lamplighter's pole taller than itself, and a little crown of bent wire it thinks nobody has noticed.
finishes.habit: It banks the hearth last thing and is the first up to blow on it.

finishes.name: Collar-rider
finishes.of: one who tells the frightened it will be all right, and makes it so
finishes.text: It rides in the passenger's collar and tells them it will be all right. So far it has not lied.
finishes.sign: It rides in a collar with only its head and lantern out. Its eyes are older than its voice.
finishes.habit: It talks low and steadily to whoever in the room is most afraid.

prongs.name: Post-sprite
prongs.of: one who cannot bear a dirty lamp
prongs.text: It moves into the lamp of any post you hold and keeps the glass clean.
prongs.sign: It sits inside a lamp glass with a rag, and a ring of clean light stands round the post.
prongs.habit: It polishes any glass it can reach: lamps, windows, your spectacles while you wear them.

finishes.name: Thimble-of-oil
finishes.of: one who has earned a small regular kindness and grown particular about it
finishes.text: The walkers leave it a thimble of oil at every post you have relit. It has grown particular about the oil.
finishes.sign: It carries a thimble on a string and sniffs what is in it before it will drink.
finishes.habit: It visits each lamp along the corridor at dusk and nods to it.

finishes.name: Door-ward Hob
finishes.of: one who checks the latch twice
finishes.text: Where it hangs its light, the door is warded. It learned the knot from watching your hands.
finishes.sign: A length of fine chain with a tiny lamp on the end, hung on whatever door you are behind.
finishes.habit: It tries every door and window before bed, in the same order, and then once more.

paths.name: Lore-sprite
paths.of: one who has to know, and then has to tell you
paths.text: It learned from you that knowing is a kind of light too.
paths.sign: Its lantern is held up to whatever is nearest, and its nose is nearly touching it.
paths.habit: It reads the labels on everything, aloud.

prongs.name: Book-wisp
prongs.of: one who reads the thing before it is clean
prongs.text: It reads the thing you dig up before you have brushed it off, and tells you what the Archive will not.
prongs.sign: Dust on its knees and a page stuck to one wing. It reads with its light held between its teeth.
prongs.habit: It sleeps in whichever book you left open, and loses your place.

finishes.name: Stack-light
finishes.of: one the learned consult and do not credit
finishes.text: The archivists pretend not to consult it. It lives in the stacks on the days you are not out.
finishes.sign: It carries a little brass dial for finding shelves, and has ink on both feet.
finishes.habit: It walks along the spines of a shelf, stops at one, and looks at you.

finishes.name: Writ-riddler
finishes.of: one who hears what was said and what was meant
finishes.text: It reads a writ and tells you what it says, what it means, and what the house hopes you will not notice.
finishes.sign: A second small face on the back of its head reads the other side of the page.
finishes.habit: It repeats what people have just said, slowly, until they hear it.

prongs.name: Grave-light
prongs.of: one who cannot leave the lonely in the dark
prongs.text: It carries its lantern among the hall's dead so they can see each other. They are grateful, and talk.
prongs.sign: Its lantern burns blue and cold, and it carries it low, at the height of someone seated.
prongs.habit: It sets its lantern down beside empty chairs and waits a while.

finishes.name: Shade-lighter
finishes.of: one who goes out to bring the lost ones in
finishes.text: Shades follow its light in from the dark line to the hearth. It has brought eleven home.
finishes.sign: A lamplighter's pole with a soft light at the tip, held out behind it for someone to follow.
finishes.habit: It walks to the gate at dusk, holds its light up to the dark line, and counts.

finishes.name: Quarrel-light
finishes.of: one who cannot hide what they think of somebody
finishes.text: It burns a different colour near anything you have a quarrel with. Near the named ones it goes white.
finishes.sign: Its light changes colour as people come in. An eye is painted on the glass, and it narrows.
finishes.habit: It turns its lantern to face whoever it has not forgiven.

prongs.name: Weather-sprite
prongs.of: one who takes on the mood of the room
prongs.text: It has learned your element and wears it: frost on its wings one week, cinders the next.
prongs.sign: Frost on its wings this week. Last week it was soot. It sneezes small weather.
prongs.habit: It sits on the sill and copies the sky: grey when it is grey, and so on.

finishes.name: Storm-in-a-jar
finishes.of: one who has bottled something up and is not sure it will hold
finishes.text: It keeps your weather in its lantern and lets it out over the green when asked. Sometimes when not.
finishes.sign: Its lantern is full of dark cloud with small lightning in it. It carries it at arm's length.
finishes.habit: It shakes the lantern to see what the weather does, and is sorry.

finishes.name: Light at the Heart
finishes.of: one whose small light holds where larger ones fail
finishes.text: At the heart of a zone its light is the only one that does not gutter. Varga walks beside it and does not say why.
finishes.sign: The air stands still round its lantern, and the flame is the one thing that does not move.
finishes.habit: It holds its lantern up at the darkest part of any stair and waits for you there.

paths.name: Pixy
paths.of: one who will not be told, and leads the rest astray for the fun of it
paths.text: It learned from you that being told is only a suggestion. It goes where it likes, and other people's eyes go after it.
paths.sign: Quick wings and a grin. Its lantern is always held just behind its back.
paths.habit: It moves one thing in every room it passes through, a little, and watches from the lintel.

prongs.name: Stray-light Pixy
prongs.of: one who likes to see where people will go if you let them
prongs.text: It hangs its lantern where the footing is worst and waits for the foe to walk to it.
prongs.sign: Dark eyes that give back no light, and a lantern hung on a long crook, away from itself.
prongs.habit: It hangs its lantern at the top of the wrong stair and listens.

finishes.name: Marsh Jack
finishes.of: one who has one trick and has never needed another
finishes.text: Its light stands over deep water looking like a lamp in a window. It has never needed a second trick.
finishes.sign: Webbed feet, wet to the knee, and a light that looks exactly like a window with someone home.
finishes.habit: It stands its lantern on the rain barrel and sits beside it, pleased.

finishes.name: Shuttered Sprite
finishes.of: one who can go dark or bright at will, and enjoys the bright part
finishes.text: It can shut its light. In that moment it is beside the foe, and then the light opens in the foe's face.
finishes.sign: A tin shutter on its lantern and a mask to match. Both snap open at once.
finishes.habit: It shuts its light, counts three, and opens it in somebody's face.

prongs.name: Flare-sprite
prongs.of: one who must be looked at when the moment comes
prongs.text: It flares on the first beat of your Pattern, and the foe spends the rest of the chain blinking.
prongs.sign: A ring of afterglow hangs where it last flared. It is already somewhere else, waiting.
prongs.habit: It flares whenever anyone in the room says its name, and sometimes when they nearly do.

finishes.name: Star-burst
finishes.of: one who would rather be a hundred small things than one sensible one
finishes.text: At the end of your chain it goes up like a rocket and comes down as a hundred small lights. All of them sting.
finishes.sign: It is not one light any longer but a drift of them, and each has a little of its grin.
finishes.habit: It scatters to every corner of the ceiling at bedtime and takes an hour to come together.

finishes.name: Blind-man's Lamp
finishes.of: one whose timing is the whole joke
finishes.text: When you parry it shines in the foe's eye at the turn. The stagger lasts a breath longer.
finishes.sign: It holds the lantern behind a cupped hand, with its eyes fixed on something far off, waiting.
finishes.habit: It uncovers its light exactly as you turn to look at it.

prongs.name: Thorn-sprite
prongs.of: one who is too small to be so sure of themselves
prongs.text: It took up a thorn. It goes in at eye height, and it is very hard to hit.
prongs.sign: It carries a thorn as long as itself, at the point, and flies at the height of your eye.
prongs.habit: It fences with the candle flame and wins.

finishes.name: Wedge-leader
finishes.of: one who talked the others into it
finishes.text: It has taught the cohort's small genii to fly in a wedge. It leads the wedge.
finishes.sign: A crown of plaited grass, and a string of smaller genii behind it in a wedge.
finishes.habit: It drills the dormitory's small genii along the curtain rail before breakfast.

finishes.name: Thorn-knight
finishes.of: one who behaves as if an army were behind them
finishes.text: It goes out with you alone and fights as if there were an army behind it. There is not. It has not noticed.
finishes.sign: Beetle-shell plates on its chest and shoulders, polished, and a thorn carried at the salute.
finishes.habit: It salutes nobody in particular before every meal.
